annotations.text:
Field-manual plates, not glossy panels.

Carried over from the shipped CSS: 78x84 cards with brass corner rivets, 13px morale bars, Impact stencil + Courier data, the --brass/--paper/--olive tokens.

New here: chamfered plate corners instead of rounded, group labels sitting on a hairline rule (ammo-crate stencil), a brass CP plate as the one emphasised control, and corner-tick portrait wells.
